facts.text: Audrey has a new place with a bigger backyard for her dogs.

evidence.quote: Woohoo! I got a new place with a bigger backyard for the pooches!

facts.text: Audrey's dogs are having fun in the new backyard, running and exploring.

evidence.quote: They love it - so much space to run and explore, sniffing out new smells. It's awesome to see them having fun.

facts.text: Audrey set up a doggy play area in the backyard with agility equipment and toys.

evidence.quote: I set up a doggy play area in the backyard with agility stuff and toys - they're loving it!
